name: DWH #SITE Projection Profile
purpose: provide the canonical public-site hierarchy projection from DWH website relations for WebEngine runtime execution
authorityFlow: WebEngine validates and indexes the projected runtime snapshot
WebEngine executes derived navigation, breadcrumbs, sitemap, routing context and composition
rules: #SITE is the semantic SiteTree runtime identity
DWH remains canonical authority for the relations behind #SITE
site.json is not a canonical authority
JSON may be used as transport serialization without becoming identity
WebEngine validates received projection before runtime use
WebEngine may derive runtime projections but must not author a competing hierarchy
WebEngine must not infer DWH relations or query DWH storage internals
